name: tn05_long_prior3
description: The four tn01_gpu PUMAs whose rare-race tract multipliers rest on about one sampled case (4703000, 4702300: R-hat ~1.07 on a tract nh_asian cell; 4702900: NH/PI tract cells; 4701900: a tract B26001 cell), with a longer HMC than tn01's: 32 chains, 500 warmup with a diagonal learned in Stan's windows, 4,000 samples kept every 40th (3,200 draws), started from screened draws of the whitening shrunk toward its mean only if too few pass (init_floor). Held-out tables scored (compare_variants.py). tn01_gpu's model with the Gaussian multiplier prior, sd 3 (+prior3). Two PUMAs per campus-gpu V100 bundle.
